issues.title: Knowledge preview lightbox: focus never enters the dialog and is not trapped or returned, and the hidden dialog stays exposed as aria-modal
issues.file: knowledge.html:114-125 (markup), knowledge.html:218-225 (.lb hidden only by opacity), knowledge.html:441-465 (openPreview/closeLightbox)
issues.description: The document preview is the main action on /knowledge. openPreview() only adds the .open class. It never moves focus into #lightbox, never traps Tab, and closeLightbox() never restores focus. While closed, #lightbox is hidden only by opacity:0/pointer-events:none, so its role='dialog' aria-modal='true' container, close button and download link stay in the accessibility tree and in the Tab order. Some screen readers treat an exposed aria-modal dialog as modal and hide the rest of the page.
reproduction_steps: Open /knowledge and Tab to the first card's 'พรีวิว' button
Press Enter: the lightbox opens, but document.activeElement is still the 'พรีวิว' button behind the overlay
Press Tab 4 times: focus cycles 'โหลด' → 'พรีวิว' → 'โหลด' → 'พรีวิว' on the cards under the overlay (closest('#lightbox') is false for every stop)
Before opening anything, the closed lightbox's 'ปิด' button and 'ดาวน์โหลด' link are Tab stops at opacity 0
issues.user_impact: Keyboard and screen-reader users open a preview but stay stuck behind it. They cannot reach the close button or the PDF iframe without tabbing through the whole page, and screen-reader users may lose the page content because an always-present aria-modal dialog is exposed.
issues.recommended_fix: Use a native <dialog> with showModal(), as gallery.js already does, or add the hidden attribute / visibility:hidden (or inert) while closed. On open, save document.activeElement, focus #lbClose and trap Tab. On close, restore focus to the opener.
issues.evidence: Keyboard run in the browser: after Enter on .doc-open, {open:true, active:'btn btn--primary doc-open', inLB:false}. Focus log after 4 Tabs: ['A.doc-dl:โหลด:inLB=false','BUTTON.doc-open:พรีวิว:inLB=false','A.doc-dl:โหลด:inLB=false','BUTTON.doc-open:พรีวิว:inLB=false']. Closed state: getComputedStyle(#lightbox) opacity '0', visibility 'visible', hidden=false, aria-hidden=null. The hidden-focusable scan lists 'BUTTON:ปิด' and 'A:ดาวน์โหลด'.

issues.title: Admin photo manager panel is not a dialog: no role, no label, and focus stays on the page behind it
issues.description: openPhotos() builds .panel without role='dialog', aria-modal or aria-labelledby, and never moves focus into it. Only Escape is handled. Tab moves through the page behind the panel, and on close the panel is removed with no focus restore.
reproduction_steps: Open admin-mock with mock_session=1 and go to อัลบั้มภาพ
Focus the first 'จัดการรูป' button and press Enter
Check the new .panel: role=null, aria-modal=null, no label; document.activeElement is still the 'จัดการรูป' button outside the panel
issues.user_impact: Screen-reader users get no announcement that a panel opened, and keyboard users must Tab blindly to reach the photo controls.
issues.recommended_fix: Reuse the openForm dialog setup: role='dialog', aria-modal='true', aria-labelledby on the h3, focus the first control on open, trap Tab, and return focus to the opener on close. A shared helper in closeLayer/openLayer would fix both panels.
issues.evidence: DOM after keyboard Enter: {role:null, modal:null, label:null, active:'BUTTON.btn btn--ghost btn--sm row__side:inPanel=false'}

issues.title: Admin edit form dialog does not trap focus or return it on close
issues.description: The form panel is correctly labelled (role=dialog, aria-modal, aria-labelledby=formTitle) and focuses the first field on open. However, Tab from the last button ('บันทึกและเผยแพร่') leaves the dialog for the page behind it ('เปิดเมนู'). On close (Escape or save), the panel is removed and focus falls to <body> instead of going back to the row that opened it.
reproduction_steps: admin-mock, logged in → กิจกรรม → focus first row → Enter
Focus the last control 'บันทึกและเผยแพร่' and press Tab: activeElement is 'เปิดเมนู', outside .panel
Reopen with Enter and press Escape: document.activeElement is BODY, and the opener row is still connected
issues.user_impact: Keyboard users lose their place in the list after every edit and can tab behind an aria-modal dialog.
issues.recommended_fix: Store the opener before opening, trap Tab/Shift+Tab inside .panel (or make #appView inert while the panel is open), and in closeLayer focus the stored opener (or the re-rendered row with the same id).
issues.evidence: Tab from the last control → 'BUTTON:เปิดเมนู:inPanel=false'. After Escape: {panels:0, active:'BODY', sameAsOpener:false, openerConnected:true}. After a save: active 'BODY'.

issues.title: Hidden mobile menu links (public site) and closed admin sidebar stay in the Tab order
issues.file: assets/mccmu.css:249-255 (.drawer closed = opacity:0 + pointer-events:none only), assets/mccmu.css:1024-1033 (.to-top), assets/admin.css:525-531 (.side translateX(-100%))
issues.description: On the public site at ≤1024px, the closed #mccDrawer is still display:block, so its 6 links are invisible Tab stops right after the burger. There is no Escape-to-close and no focus handling. The back-to-top button is likewise focusable while at opacity 0. In admin at ≤860px, the closed sidebar is moved off-screen with transform only, so its 10 nav/logout buttons remain focusable off-screen.
reproduction_steps: Open / at 352px width and press Tab from the top
After 'เมนู', focus goes to 'หน้าแรก Home', 'กิจกรรม Activities' … 'ติดต่อเรา Contact', all with ancestor opacity 0 and the drawer closed
In admin-mock on mobile width, check #sideNav: transform matrix(...,-282,0), visibility visible, 10 focusable children, open=false
issues.user_impact: Keyboard and switch users on phones and tablets hit 6 (public) or 10 (admin) invisible stops with no visible focus, which looks like focus has disappeared.
issues.recommended_fix: Add visibility:hidden to the closed state (with transition: visibility 0s .2s so it still fades), or toggle the inert/hidden attribute in the burger handler. Add Escape-to-close that returns focus to the burger. Apply the same treatment to .to-top when it lacks .show, and to .side when it lacks .open on mobile.
issues.evidence: Real-Tab focus log on /: entries 5-10 = 'A.:หน้าแรก Home' … 'A.:ติดต่อเรา Contact' with op:0. Admin: {open:false, transform:'matrix(1, 0, 0, 1, -282, 0)', vis:'visible', inert:false, focusablesInside:10, w:352}.

issues.title: No skip link on any page, and no <main> landmark on 5 of 6 public pages
issues.file: index.html, activities.html, halal-map.html, knowledge.html, about.html (content sections sit directly in <body>); assets/site.js:37-58 (nav injected with no skip link)
issues.description: Only gallery.html wraps its content in <main id='main-content'>. The other five pages have header/nav/footer landmarks but no main, and no page has a 'skip to content' link. Keyboard users must tab through the brand link, 5 nav links, the CTA, 2 language buttons and the burger (plus 6 hidden drawer links on mobile) on every page.
reproduction_steps: On each page run document.querySelectorAll('main,[role=main]').length: 0 on 5 pages, 1 on /gallery
Press Tab once on any page: the first stop is 'MCCMU home' (no skip link)
issues.user_impact: Screen-reader users can't jump to the main content by landmark, and keyboard users repeat 10-16 Tab stops on every page.
issues.recommended_fix:
Wrap each page's content between #site-nav and #site-footer in
. Have site.js prepend ข้ามไปเนื้อหาหลัก, visually hidden until :focus.
issues.evidence: Audit script landmarks: {main:0, header:1, nav:1, footer:1} on /, /knowledge, /activities, /halal-map, /about; {main:1} on /gallery. grep -i 'skip' across *.html, assets/*.css and assets/*.js: no matches.

issues.title: Auto-scrolling carousels have no pause control, ignore prefers-reduced-motion and keep moving while focused
issues.file: assets/api.js:1131-1166 (_initCarousel: setInterval(tick, 3800) with no reduced-motion check), knowledge.html:330-360 (doc carousel setInterval(advance, 3500))
issues.description: _initCarousel and the knowledge doc carousel auto-advance every 3.5-3.8 s. They pause only on mouseenter/touch, not on focusin, offer no pause/stop button (WCAG 2.2.2), and ignore prefers-reduced-motion. The featured slider (api.js:478) does check reduced motion, so the two code paths are inconsistent.
reproduction_steps: Open /halal-map with the keyboard and Tab into a card's 'เปิดแผนที่' link
Wait about 4 s: the track scrolls by one card, so the focused card can move out of view
With OS 'reduce motion' on, the carousels still auto-scroll (no matchMedia check in _initCarousel)
issues.user_impact: Content moves under keyboard and screen-magnifier users while they read. Users with vestibular disorders get continuous motion they asked the OS to suppress.
issues.recommended_fix: In _initCarousel and the doc carousel, skip the interval when matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)') matches, pause on focusin and resume on focusout, and add a visible pause/play toggle (aria-pressed) next to the prev/next buttons.
issues.evidence: Code: api.js:1165 `if (overflowing()) timer = setInterval(tick, opts.interval || 3800);` with no reduced-motion guard (grep shows the only reduced-motion check in api.js is at line 478, for the featured slider). knowledge.html startAuto(): `timer = setInterval(advance, 3500)`, listeners only for mouseenter/mouseleave/touchstart/touchend.

issues.title: Prayer 'next' live region re-announces every 30 seconds
issues.file: index.html:61 (aria-live='polite'), assets/api.js:1015-1026 (tick clears and rebuilds #pNext, setInterval 30000)
issues.description: tick() runs every 30 s and always clears and re-appends the child nodes of #pNext, even when the text hasn't changed. With aria-live='polite', each rebuild is an addition, so screen readers repeat 'ถัดไป ฟัจร์ อีก 4 ชม. 51 นาที' about twice a minute for as long as the home page is open.
reproduction_steps: Open / with a screen reader
Wait 30 s: #pNext children are removed and re-added (api.js:1016-1021), which triggers a polite announcement each time
issues.user_impact: Repeated interruptions while a screen-reader user reads the rest of the home page.
issues.recommended_fix: Remove aria-live from #pNext (the countdown doesn't need to be pushed), or only update it when the next prayer changes and compare text before touching the DOM. If a live update is wanted, announce only the prayer change through a separate visually hidden role='status'.
issues.evidence:
DOM:

. Code: `_clear(next); next.appendChild(...)` inside tick(), and `MCCMU._prayerTimer = setInterval(tick, 30000)`. Observed text changing from 'อีก 4 ชม. 52 นาที' to 'อีก 4 ชม. 51 นาที' between reads.

issues.title: Admin toasts (save success/failure, validation) and login errors are not announced
issues.description: toast() appends a plain <div class='toast'> to <body> with no role='status' or aria-live, and removes it after 2.6 s (6 s for errors). This covers every save confirmation, 'บันทึกไม่สำเร็จ: …' errors and required-field messages. Login errors also go into #loginMsg as a plain div. After a save the form closes and focus falls to <body>, so the toast is the only feedback.
reproduction_steps: admin-mock, logged in → กิจกรรม → open a row → click 'บันทึกและเผยแพร่'
Inspect .toast: role=null, aria-live=null, no live ancestor; activeElement is BODY
issues.user_impact: Screen-reader admins get no confirmation that content was saved or published, and no error when a save fails or a required field is empty.
issues.recommended_fix: Create one persistent live region at startup (<div role='status' aria-live='polite'>, plus role='alert' for bad=true) and write toast text into it. Give #loginMsg's alert role='alert'.
issues.evidence: {toast:'บันทึกแล้ว · ขึ้นเว็บภายใน ~3 นาที', role:null, live:null, liveAncestor:false, active:'BODY'}

issues.title: Global muted/eyebrow text colours fail AA on the paper background
issues.file: assets/mccmu.css:28 (--muted #7A7290), assets/mccmu.css:83-88 (.eyebrow → --grape-500), assets/mccmu.css:92 (.en), assets/mccmu.css:424 (map card coral), knowledge.html:162-163 (.count-badge, .doc-sort-hint)

On the home 'Quick links' map card, the coral tag and CTA (#E76F51 on white) are 3.09:1. The 'EN' label in the language switch is #7A7290 on #F5F3FF at 11 px (4.13:1).
reproduction_steps: Run the contrast walker on / and /knowledge

Failures: eyebrows 'ย้อนดู', 'หยิบมาอ่าน', 'บริการของชมรม', 'สรุปเนื้อหา · ฮาลาเกาะฮ์' 3.96:1; .en 'Recap', 'Picked for you', 'Lecture Notes' 4.23:1; '18 ไฟล์' count badge and 'เพิ่มล่าสุดก่อน' 4.23:1; svc__tag 'Halal Map' and svc__go 'ดูแผนที่' 3.09:1; lang 'EN' 4.13:1

issues.title: Halal map page puts about 29 Google Maps iframes in the Tab order; one loaded embed swallowed 30+ Tab presses
issues.file: assets/api.js:848 (place card renderer: .place__map iframe, no tabindex), halal-map.html:101-102
issues.description: Each place card embeds an interactive Google Maps iframe before its 'เปิดแผนที่' link, and the iframes have no tabindex='-1'. Keyboard users must go through every embed, and a loaded embed contributes its own internal controls. In testing, 30 Tab presses from the food 'ถัดไป' button stayed inside the first map. A further 60 presses only reached card 19.
reproduction_steps: Open /halal-map, focus the food carousel 'ถัดไป' button
Press Tab 30 times: document.activeElement is still the first iframe 'แผนที่ ก๋วยเตี๋ยวเนื้อตุ๋น…'
Press Tab 60 more times: activeElement is iframe 'แผนที่ ครัวคุณอา (The R Halal Kitchen)', having passed 19 'เปิดแผนที่' links
issues.user_impact: Reaching the masjid list, contact link or footer by keyboard takes 100+ key presses, which makes the page impractical without a mouse.
issues.recommended_fix: Set tabindex='-1' on the per-card preview iframes (and optionally aria-hidden='true'), since the 'เปิดแผนที่ <name>' link already gives the same destination. Better still, use a static thumbnail with click-to-load, which also helps performance. Keep the one large overview map focusable.
issues.evidence: iframes: n=30, 0 with a tabindex attribute. Focus logs after the Tab runs are quoted in the reproduction steps.

issues.title: In English mode, Thai backend content is marked lang='en'; in Thai mode, English labels are not marked lang='en'
issues.file: assets/i18n.js:371 (sets html lang only); assets/api.js renderers; assets/mccmu.css:92 (.en spans)
issues.description: The toggle correctly switches <html lang> to 'en', but database text (event titles, descriptions, doc titles, places) stays Thai by design and carries no lang='th'. Screen readers then read Thai with an English voice. In Thai mode, the bilingual .en spans ('Recap', 'Picked for you', drawer 'Home') aren't marked lang='en'.

issues.title: Toggle and current-state semantics missing: language switch, nav current page, featured dots
issues.file: assets/i18n.js:383-391 (updateSwitch toggles .is-on only), assets/site.js:31-33 (nav uses class is-active, no aria-current), assets/api.js:441-457 (feat dots use .is-active only)
issues.description: The TH/EN buttons show the active language only through the .is-on class and thumb position, with no aria-pressed. Inspect .nav__links a.is-active: aria-current null

issues.title: Heading levels skip (footer h4 after page h1/h2; about timeline/contact h4 under h2); admin app has no visible h1

issues.title: Starting a video drops keyboard focus to <body>
issues.file: assets/videos.js:118-126 (start() replaces the focused poster button with the iframe)
issues.description: Activating 'เล่นคลิป …' calls player.replaceChildren(iframe), which removes the focused button, so focus resets to the top of the document.

The focused element is removed, and the next Tab starts from the top of the page

issues.title: Accessible names that hide context or contradict visible text
issues.file: about.html:134,136 (aria-label='Instagram'/'Facebook' on links showing '@muslimclub.cmu'/'MuslimClubCMU'); about.html:256-262 (copy feedback via textContent only); assets/admin.js:1086-1088 ('จัดการรูป' repeated per row), assets/admin.js:1297-1301 (photo row 'เลื่อนไปก่อนหน้า'/'ตั้งเป็นรูปปก' without photo number)
issues.description: On /about, the contact links' aria-label replaces their visible handle, which breaks WCAG 2.5.3 label-in-name for voice-control users, and the 'คัดลอกแล้ว' confirmation isn't announced. In admin, every album row has an identical 'จัดการรูป' button, and photo rows repeat 'เลื่อนไปก่อนหน้า / ตั้งเป็นรูปปก / เอาออกจากอัลบั้ม' with no photo or album name.

admin-mock → อัลบั้มภาพ: button list shows 'จัดการรูป' twice with no album name
